how: Indoor real-snow slope (not a simulator) with lifts and terrain parks, skis and jackets included in the ticket.
Wild Wadi water park has FlowRider-style standing-wave surf simulators (Wipeout and Riptide).
Sunrise hot air balloon flights over the Dubai desert run daily from October to May.
Dubai metro area is flat desert and coast with no mountains; the nearest range is the Hajar Mountains around Hatta, about 134 km east (roughly 1.5 hours by road).
Flat desert and coast with no gorges; the nearest wadis and canyons are in the Hajar Mountains near Hatta or Ras Al Khaimah, roughly 1.5-2 hours away.
Flat alluvial desert with no natural caves in the metro area; the nearest caves are in the Hajar Mountains (Hatta/Fujairah/Oman), roughly 1.5-2 hours away.
No mountain terrain or ice track in the metro area; the nearest mountain toboggan ride is at Jebel Jais in Ras Al Khaimah, roughly 1.5-2 hours away.
